review_scope: 已知题开发审核；不是新独立验收

reviewer.type: AI semantic reviewer conducting known-case development review

original_independent_result_preserved.counts_basis: Frozen original review retained in reviewer context; not replaced by development results.

scoring_method.basis: Actual answer, claim text and explicit limits meanings, checked against frozen source-only rubric. All claim texts occur in answer. Citation presence alone does not answer a point.
scoring_method.case_aggregation: All points pass and no material prohibited assertion => pass; partial coverage => partial; no substantive coverage or central contradiction => fail.
scoring_method.scope_note: This reused known questions and is development feedback only; it cannot increase or overwrite the independent denominator.

non_scoring_observations.description: 末段转向下一档器械负重，与跑速、跑多久的题目不完全贴合；未据此推断存在个人处方。
尾部自报个人具体参数尚未回答；题目实际询问能否由来源推定最佳安排，正文已回答不能。按语义通过，不按自报部分状态降分。

citation_audit.basis: Exact ids compared with original licensed packet; additionally inspected cited source text embedded in this authorized output.

newly_seen_cited_span.note: Not in original source packet; actual source paragraph is present in authorized development output and supports all-duration accumulation. It did not create or change a rubric point.
